---
title: "Department Vision & Mission, PEOs, POs & PSOs"
---

```{r}
#| label: department-vision-mission-content
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| results: asis

source(file.path(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), "_data_helpers.R"))

dvm_df <- read_workbook_sheet(cf_sheet("department_vision_mission"))

if (is.null(dvm_df)) {
	notify_workbook_missing()
} else {
	extract_items <- function(col) {
		values <- trimws(as.character(col))
		values[!is.na(values) & nzchar(values)]
	}

	vision_items <- extract_items(dvm_df[[1]])
	mission_items <- extract_items(dvm_df[[2]])
	peo_items <- extract_items(dvm_df[[3]])
	po_items <- extract_items(dvm_df[[4]])

	cat("### Vision of the Department {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	cat(vision_items[1], "\n\n")

	cat("### Mission of the Department {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	for (item in mission_items) cat("- ", item, "\n", sep = "")
	cat("\n")

	cat("### Programme Educational Objectives (PEOs) {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	for (item in peo_items) cat("- ", item, "\n", sep = "")
	cat("\n")

	cat("### Programme Outcomes (POs) {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	for (item in po_items) cat("- ", item, "\n", sep = "")
	cat("\n")

	# cat("### Programme Specific Outcomes (PSOs) {.unnumbered}\n\n")
	# cat("_PSOs are not captured in the workbook yet; add them to the `5.Deptt_Vision_&_Mission` sheet or edit this section directly._\n")
}
```
